name: Correction Dynamic
tagline: Who catches her. Filled only when the Relationship Dynamic reads brat.
body: A brat's profile names her corrector. The corrector's profile may carry the mirror field. Leaving it unfilled on a brat is a gap, not a neutral state — an uncorrected brat has no one to escalate toward, and the dynamic collapses into noise.
rules: Filled only if Relationship Dynamic reads brat; otherwise N/A
